import argparse
import sys

def convert_text(text, case):
    if case == 'uppercase':
        return text.upper()
    elif case == 'lowercase':
        return text.lower()
    elif case == 'title':
        return text.title()
    elif case == 'sentence':
        return text.capitalize()
    else:
        raise ValueError("Invalid case option")

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert text to various cases.")
    parser.add_argument('input', nargs='?', help='Input text or file')
    parser.add_argument('--case', choices=['uppercase', 'lowercase', 'title', 'sentence'], required=True, help='Case to convert text to')
    
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.input is None:
        text = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    else:
        try:
            with open(args.input, 'r') as file:
                text = file.read().strip()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Error: File '{args.input}' not found.\n")
            sys.exit(1)

    converted_text = convert_text(text, args.case)
    print(converted_text)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
